confirmatory_hierarchy.reporting_rule: Evaluate in this order without tuning. Secondary results cannot rescue a failed primary replication.

interpretation.estimand: A pre-fixed source-specific contrast in model margin under unrelated reference substitutions.
interpretation.assumption: Balanced donor permutations estimate nuisance response only if unrelated reference donors are exchangeable for that nuisance.
forbidden_claims: causal effect of the true second image

novelty_boundary: RMCD already forms relevance-weighted signed sums of logits from multiple relevant and irrelevant contexts; generic multi-context subtraction is prior art.
MultiSHAP already uses Shapley interaction indices for model-agnostic multimodal synergy attribution; a generic factorial interaction score is prior art.
Any surviving claim must be specific to source-bound multi-reference retrieval and supported by held-out ranking gains, explicit-negative discrimination, and cross-model evidence.

noncomposition_sensitivity_pool.reason: All 102 clean non-Composition rows occur in only two reference components.
